# Photo cropper

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-cropper/

Crop a photo by drawing a selection or entering exact pixel coordinates. Use square, portrait or landscape ratios to frame the part you want.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Select a 320 × 360 region from a photo by entering the left, top, width and height values.

## Limits and checks

The complete crop rectangle must stay inside the original image. Save the original if you may need another crop later.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
